resources.string: Glass Home – Turn Off and Sleep Timer
Lets Glass Home put the TV to sleep (Control Centre\'s Turn Off and Sleep Timer) on TVs that don\'t allow it any other way. It is only used when you ask, and reads nothing on screen.

Makes the remote\'s Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, Quick Settings and microphone buttons work with Glass Home, and opens the App Switcher when Home is pressed twice. It only acts on those buttons and reads nothing on screen.
